# `sector_classification_evidence`

**Sector classification evidence**

Separate qualified FEC and lobbying measures with source-local classifications, exact evidence and visible uncertainty.

**Coverage.** Derived. Bounded selected source profiles and a versioned broad-sector mapping. Unknown classifications, unresolved quarters and overlapping issues remain visible; not a national or complete annual sector total. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `sector_classification_evidence.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `record_id` | `VARCHAR` | Deterministic identity bound to source selections and mapping revision. |
| `source_namespace` | `VARCHAR` | FEC committee or LDA client identity namespace; proposed cross-source links stay separate. |
| `native_entity_id` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source-local ID; names do not establish cross-source identity. |
| `sector_codes_json` | `VARCHAR` | Distinct proposed sector codes; multiple codes do not duplicate additive money. |
| `classification_status` | `VARCHAR` | Supported context, uncertain industry, or unresolved identity association. |
| `classification_scheme` | `VARCHAR` | The retained NAICS vintage, separate from LDA issue vocabulary. |
| `mapping_version` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit revision of curator assignments and their evidence. |
| `method` | `VARCHAR` | Curated business-evidence method. Name-only or issue-code industry inference refuses. |
| `applicable_start` | `VARCHAR` | First reporting date for which this mapping was declared applicable. |
| `applicable_end` | `VARCHAR` | Last reporting date for which this mapping was declared applicable. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | Date classification evidence was reviewed, not a relationship effective date. |
| `evidence_json` | `VARCHAR` | Assignment evidence with native IDs, source digests, original locators and limitations. |
| `uncertainty` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit limits of curator classification or identity association. |
| `association_json` | `VARCHAR` | Separately retained unresolved identity proposal; never used to join money. |
